title: Coin Change
statement: You are given a list of coin denominations coins (positive integers, each usable an unlimited number of times) and an integer amount. Return the fewest number of coins needed to make up exactly amount. If that amount cannot be made up by any combination of the coins, return -1. amount = 0 always returns 0.
hints: Brute-force trying every combination of coins blows up exponentially; instead build up the answer for every amount from 0 to the target once each.
Let dp[a] be the fewest coins to make amount a. dp[a] = 1 + min(dp[a - c]) over every coin c <= a, with dp[0] = 0 and unreachable amounts left at infinity.

Initialize a dp array of size amount+1 with dp[0] = 0 and the rest infinity; for a from 1 to amount, for each coin c <= a, update dp[a] = min(dp[a], dp[a-c] + 1); return dp[amount] unless it's still infinity, then -1.
